content.text: Jump to content Help From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia This is a set category. It should only contain pages that are Water buffalo breeds or lists of Water buffalo breeds, as well as subcategories containing those things (themselves set categories). Topics about Water buffalo breeds in general should be placed in relevant topic categories. Domestic water buffalo are the descendants of the Wild Asian Water buffalo, now designated an endangered species. They have been bred for human use for thousands of years, predominantly in Asia. Their main domestic uses are as draught animals, dairy producers and meat production. The main page for this category is "List of water buffalo breeds".
